title: Configuration at a designated state
statement: Given a configuration $d$ of a machine with $k+2$ work tapes, whose states are record states, a key $q$ and a phase value $p$ of the type assigned to that key determine a configuration with the same input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions, and output as $d$, but with its state replaced by the pair $(q,p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and record states on input $x$
$p$ is a phase value assigned to $q$
